stem:
The diagram shows Inaya's simple pendulum with a steel bob. O is the mean position; P and Q are the extreme positions.

Which motion of the bob is one complete oscillation?

options.text: From O to P, then through O to Q, then back to O.
O to P, then back to O.
An oscillation cannot be completed if counting starts at P.

teacher.key_rationale: One oscillation from the mean goes to one extreme, then the other extreme, and returns to the mean. Stopping after one side, counting only the first swing out, or forbidding a start at an extreme, truncates or mis-scopes that path.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote force diagram into a labelled simple pendulum with mean O and extremes P, Q.
